label: Bible Study
prompt: In hope of eternal life, which God, that cannot _____, promised before the world began;
verse: In hope of eternal life, which God, that cannot lie, promised before the world began;
note: Eternal life promised before the world began — by the one God who cannot lie.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Unto Timothy, my own _____ in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.
verse: Unto Timothy, my own son in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.
note: Paul calls Timothy his own son in the faith — no blood relation, but family all the same.

label: Sunday School
prompt: In Gibeon the LORD appeared to Solomon in a _____ by night: and God said, Ask what I shall give thee.
verse: In Gibeon the LORD appeared to Solomon in a dream by night: and God said, Ask what I shall give thee.
note: At Gibeon, God appeared to young Solomon in a dream with a blank check: 'Ask what I shall give thee.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: I do not _____ the grace of God: for if righteousness come by the law, then Christ is dead in vain.
verse: I do not frustrate the grace of God: for if righteousness come by the law, then Christ is dead in vain.
note: 'Frustrate' means set aside — if law-keeping could make us righteous, Paul says, the cross was in vain.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Through the tender mercy of our God; whereby the _____ from on high hath visited us,
verse: Through the tender mercy of our God; whereby the dayspring from on high hath visited us,
note: Zacharias' song over newborn John: the 'dayspring from on high' — the sunrise — has visited us.
